notes.title: Game Update v5.1.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1945 - update 3.1.1
notes.content:
Change: The game balance in the 'Wulkow' scenario.
Update: Some German transport vehicles to Sd.Kfz 7's.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1945 version 3.1.0 update
notes.content:
Change: The game balance in the 'Wulkow' scenario as it was still too difficult.
Change: The tree density on some maps.
Fix: Some terrain was not providing cover against shooting, as per the terrain effects chart.
Fix: Some woodland hexes were incorrectly allowing units to pass through them in a single movement action."
Update: Improved AI behaviour in some scenarios.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1945 - version 3.0.4 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: The bonus 'Twilight' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
[*] Change: The game balance in the 'Wulkow' scenario as it was too difficult.
[*] Fix: The campaign names did not always display correctly in the campaign victory display.
[/list]

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1945 - version 3.0.3 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix: Issue of an aircraft image sometimes appearing after selecting off board artillery.
[*] Fix: Some button alignment issues.
[*] Fix: Some spelling errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1945 version 3.0.2 update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1945 v3.0.1 Update
notes.content: Fix: An issue where the Wulkow scenario would not load.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1945 v3.0.0 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add: Weapon animations.
[*] Change: Improved computer player A.I.
[*] Change: Improved U.I.
[*] Change: Reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Play balance in the Wuklow mission after some A.I. changes.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount/dismount buttons.
[/list]

notes.title: Update.
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with the Hatten-Rittershoffen mission. The trapped infantry would not move out of the houses when rescued. They now move as expected.

Any issues let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Add: Steam Achievements.
Fix: Off screen artillery.
Fix. Minor bug fixes.

If you have any issues please let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: New Patch Released!
notes.content:
We’ve just released a small update patch for “Tank Battle: 1945”.  This update includes a number of fixes and general improvements.

[list][*]Fix: Constant highlighting of formation button.
[*]Fix: Appearance of fields terrain.
[*]Fix: Behaviour of Engineers.
[*]Add: Missing image to Terrain Chart.
[*]Add: Tooltips to map-overlay.
[*]Change: Improve UI.[/list]

We hope everyone is enjoying the game, but if anyone has any issues or questions, please just let us know at support@hexwar.com.

~The HexWar Games Team.

notes.title: v 1.6
notes.content:
We've just released a patch for Tank Battle: 1945!

[list]
[*]Add: A whole new way to play, 'Historical Mode'.  This is now an option on starting a new mission.
[*]Add: 'Historical Mode' preference to the settings menu.
[*]Add: Change log for all updates in the latest edition of the game.
[*]Add: Change log to the help menu.
[/list]

Thanks for supporting our games! 

~ The HexWar Games Team
